long_biography.plain_text:
Before creating coeo, Haverkamp served on the executive board of GFKL Financial Services, working in claims management and financial software. He founded coeo in 2010 as a German debt-collection provider serving e-commerce, payment, telecommunications and energy clients. The company combined debt purchasing with technology-led collections and later brought in Waterland as a majority growth partner.

Haverkamp remained co-owner and managing director as coeo expanded into Austria and the Netherlands, then stepped back from management while continuing as an active shareholder. Under the partnership, coeo grew across Europe and invested in digital collections and artificial intelligence. A 2025 agreement transferred the shares held by Waterland, Haverkamp and other minority investors to doValue.
long_biography.html:
Before creating coeo, Haverkamp served on the executive board of GFKL Financial Services, working in claims management and financial software. He founded coeo in 2010 as a German debt-collection provider serving e-commerce, payment, telecommunications and energy clients. The company combined debt purchasing with technology-led collections and later brought in Waterland as a majority growth partner.

Haverkamp remained co-owner and managing director as coeo expanded into Austria and the Netherlands, then stepped back from management while continuing as an active shareholder. Under the partnership, coeo grew across Europe and invested in digital collections and artificial intelligence. A 2025 agreement transferred the shares held by Waterland, Haverkamp and other minority investors to doValue.
